datasets.note: No public benchmark measures an agent-harness control plane (scheduling runs of headless CLI agents onto pull-based workers), so there is no published score to compare against. The closest public data, the Azure Functions and Alibaba cluster traces, are workloads without an oracle; see BENCHMARKING.md, Datasets.

results.note: Claim latency (queued to leased) with no backlog, 0.5 s runs, 3 server replicas and 4 workers on k3d; this suite uses 1 replica and measures across all e2e probes.
